title: US smartphone shipments fell 9% YoY in Q3 as memory costs hit Android OEMs, especially at the low end; Apple's share rose from 50% to 57%, Samsung holds at 25% (Maurice Klaehne/Counterpoint Research)
summary: Maurice Klaehne / Counterpoint Research: US smartphone shipments fell 9% YoY in Q3 as memory costs hit Android OEMs, especially at the low end; Apple's share rose from 50% to 57%, Samsung holds at 25% — - US smartphone shipments fell 9% YoY in Q3 as rising memory costs weighed on Android OEMs, especially at the low end.
